prompt: A café offers 3 starters, 6 main courses and 2 desserts. A meal is one starter, one main course and one dessert. How many different meals can be chosen?
hint: Multiply the number of choices for each course.
explanation: Each of the 3 starters can go with each of the 6 main courses, which gives 3 × 6 = 18 pairs. Each pair can go with each of the 2 desserts: 18 × 2 = 36 meals.
source_ref: Pearson Edexcel GCSE Mathematics (1MA1) content reference N5
